exact_supporting_quote: Presence of 100% fruit set in selfed inflorescences reveals that the species is highly self-compatible and predominantly self-pollinated.

exact_supporting_quote: Bagging of single inflorescence (in which 4–5 male flowers had initiated opening) in 35 different trees resulted in 100% fruit set revealing thereby that the species is geitonogamous.
